'''Spore-Tending Unit''' was a model of an [[Environmental droid|environmental]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] utilized by automatic systems of the ''[[Jannimak]]'', a [[Research vessel|bio-research vessel]] built to accommodate a wide range of exotic species.<ref name="wreckage">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Wreckage on Dantooine|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> Spore-Tending Unit was an advanced version of [[Caretaker Probe droid]].

After the [[Crash of the Jannimak|''Jannimak''{{'s}} crash]] around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> these droids were deployed by the ship to spread the spore exposure, distributing poisonous micro fungus across the [[Sporefall]] area of the [[Jannimak crash site|crash]].<ref name="sporefall">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|[[Sporefall]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

One Spore-Tending Unit, refitted to serve the purpose of a material synthetization droid, was located in the [[Tram Market]] on [[Zakuul]].<ref name="zakuul">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Tram Market]]|[[Zakuul]]}}</ref>
